name: client-code-gen
description: OpenAPI generation for the FAM API clients

scripts.gen-api-client: rm -rf gen/fam-api && openapi-generator-cli generate -i fam-openapi.json --generator-name typescript-axios -o gen/fam-api --config api.json && node postgen.mjs
scripts.dockergen-api-client-bash: docker run --rm -v ${PWD}:/local openapitools/openapi-generator-cli:v7.5.0 generate -i local/fam-openapi.json -g typescript-axios --config local/api.json -o /local/gen/fam-api
